title: New Dance (Riding The Waves )
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 1 "balance wave of four" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 4 "neighbors allemande right ½ to come back to original neighbor" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 5 "neighbors balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 are too far apart to balance.
Row 8 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
